scheme.credential: credential_cases: credential_sha256 is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of 'aweb.human-credential/1' and a newline, then the credential's canonical JSON; fingerprint is its first 16 hex characters in groups of four
scheme.delivery: delivery_cases: a delivery body to the app's human origin; app is the app's declaration and whether it enables the optional security key; state is whether (installation, role, principal) has a current holding and what the registry reports for the principal (member_human, not_member, not_human, unavailable); expected_subject is the subject the app builds, null when the body is refused before it; verifier_code is the owner-act/1 refusal behind a 403, or null when the act verifies; result is the HTTP status, detail and response
scheme.manifest: manifest_cases: a version 3 manifest's owner_acts; error is the manifest refusal code, or null when it is valid
scheme.registry: delivery_cases' verifier.registry says whether stage 2 can read the team key; the forged_signature cases pair a present and an absent holding under each, and the pair's results are equal
scheme.role: role_cases pin the declared role name, which is the act's role, against the owner-act/1 signer: a leading letter, at most 64 bytes
scheme.signing: standard base64 with padding of the owner-act/1 signing bytes
